The Regal Treasure 4-in-1 Dry Fruit Set is a statement piece for any celebration. Featuring four premium containers with individually designed lids, this set is perfect for serving dry fruits, sweets, or snacks in style. The dual-tone silver and gold finish adds a royal touch, while the central handle makes it easy to carry and present. Its elegant craftsmanship and durable build make it not just a serveware item but also a beautiful décor element for your dining table. A thoughtful gift choice for Diwali, weddings, or festive occasions.
